# möbius Gateway 0.15.19

Swarm participants automatically attach the existing primary workspaces used by every current member Bot’s conversations. The gateway deduplicates paths and refreshes attachments before new work, including for existing participants and after membership changes. Ordinary chats retain their own workspace boundaries.

Uses the existing folder validation, attachment limits, sandbox permissions, and runtime replacement path. Includes the signed and notarized Mac companion. Protocol 76 and checkpoint format 14 are unchanged; existing conversations need no conversion. Packages preserve LICENSE and NOTICE.
